t: A guarantee attached to the text itself
a: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ
p: Innā naḥnu nazzalna-dh-dhikra wa innā lahu la-ḥāfiẓūn.
m: Indeed, it is We who sent down the message [i.e., the Qur’ān], and indeed, We will be its guardian.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
